brief: A free, privacy-first, offline gym and strength training log for Android. Built for lifters who demand fast, ad-free set logging, barbell plate math, and exercise video guidance with zero surveillance.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px in the Android status bar and app launcher, high contrast on dark obsidian gym UI (#0C0B0A), works in single-color gold/white/black, evokes raw strength and thunder.

concepts.name: The Kinetic Bolt
concepts.idea: A chiseled heavy-gauge Z with integrated lightning strike, 180° rotational symmetry, and raw barbell presence.
rationale: Pure geometric letterform reads instantly as an Android launcher icon at 16 px
Thunderbolt kick captures the mythical power of Zeus without cheesy lightning clichés
Forged iron bar weight (40px) matches heavy Olympic plate proportions
100/100 production-readiness score with exact 45° snap angles

concepts.name: The Iron Plate
concepts.idea: Olympic 45lb/20kg barbell plate with a crisp lightning bolt carved in negative space.
rationale: Instant gym category recognition with Olympic plate geometry
Negative space bolt rewards a second look and holds up in one-colour
Pure circle footprint ideal for circular app avatars

concepts.name: The Twin Plate
concepts.idea: Two brutalist interlocking plate blocks forging a Z and bolt along the diagonal fissure.
rationale: Brutalist architectural strength with dual stacked iron masses
High contrast negative space fissure creates a natural lightning strike
Modular form extends easily into gym apparel patterns

recommendation: The Kinetic Bolt — maximum ownership, immediate letter recognition, and flawless scalability across Android mobile widgets, status bars, and app icons.
next_steps: Kit complete: full color palette, mono/reversed variants, and web icons exported
Android launcher adaptive icons (ic_1024.png and ic_fg_1024.png) rendered
Brand guidelines and usage documentation published
